theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.coeff_fmaj_nonneg (μ : YoungDiagram) (d : ℕ) :
0 ≤ (fmaj μ).coeff d

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.coeff_fmaj (μ : YoungDiagram) (d : ℕ) :
(fmaj μ).coeff d = ↑{S : MajStandardization.SYTe μ | d = S.maj}.card

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.qFactorial_eq_schurElt_mul_fmaj {F : Type u_1} [Field F] (μ : YoungDiagram) (Q : F) (hQ0 : Q ≠ 0) (hQ1 : Q ≠ 1) :
∏ m ∈ Finset.range μ.cells.card, (1 - Q ^ (m + 1)) / (1 - Q) = SchurWeyl.schurElt Q μ * (Polynomial.aeval Q) (fmaj μ)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.fmaj_mul_qHook (μ : YoungDiagram) :
(∏ c ∈ μ.cells, SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.qIntPoly ℤ (QBeta.WenzlWeight.hook μ c)) * fmaj μ = Polynomial.X ^ QBeta.WenzlWeight.nPart μ * ∏ m ∈ Finset.range μ.cells.card, SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.qIntPoly ℤ (m + 1)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.fmaj_mul_hook (μ : YoungDiagram) :
fmaj μ * ∏ c ∈ μ.cells, (1 - Polynomial.X ^ QBeta.WenzlWeight.hook μ c) = Polynomial.X ^ QBeta.WenzlWeight.nPart μ * ∏ m ∈ Finset.range μ.cells.card, (1 - Polynomial.X ^ (m + 1))

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.one_sub_X_pow_ne_zero {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
1 - Polynomial.X ^ k ≠ 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.eExp_eq_nPart (N : ℕ) (μ : YoungDiagram) (hμ : μ.colLen 0 ≤ N) :
PrincipalSchur.eExp N μ = QBeta.WenzlWeight.nPart μ

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.fmaj_rowYD (n : ℕ) :
fmaj (rowYD n) = 1

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.SYTe.e_rowYD {n : ℕ} (S : MajStandardization.SYTe (rowYD n)) (c : MajStandardization.Cell (rowYD n)) :
↑(S.e c) = (↑c).2

def QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.SYTe.rowStd (n : ℕ) :
MajStandardization.SYTe (rowYD n)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.SYTe.maj_rowYD {n : ℕ} (S : MajStandardization.SYTe (rowYD n)) :
S.maj = 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.hook_rowYD {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (Q : R) (n : ℕ) :
∏ c ∈ (rowYD n).cells, (1 - Q ^ QBeta.WenzlWeight.hook (rowYD n) c) = ∏ m ∈ Finset.range n, (1 - Q ^ (m + 1))

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.eExp_rowYD (N n : ℕ) :
PrincipalSchur.eExp N (rowYD n) = 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.colLen_rowYD_le (n : ℕ) :
(rowYD n).colLen 0 ≤ 1

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.colLen_rowYD (n : ℕ) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < n) :
(rowYD n).colLen j = 1

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.rowLen_rowYD_pos (n : ℕ) {i : ℕ} (hi : 0 < i) :
(rowYD n).rowLen i = 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.rowLen_rowYD_zero (n : ℕ) :
(rowYD n).rowLen 0 = n

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.card_rowYD (n : ℕ) :
(rowYD n).cells.card = n

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.cells_rowYD (n : ℕ) :
(rowYD n).cells = {0} ×ˢ Finset.range n

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.mem_rowYD {n : ℕ} {c : ℕ × ℕ} :
c ∈ rowYD n ↔ c.1 = 0 ∧ c.2 < n

def QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.rowYD (n : ℕ) :
YoungDiagram

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.dvd_prod_sub_one {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (Q : R) (N K : ℕ) (μ : YoungDiagram) (hK : K + μ.colLen 0 ≤ N + 1) :
Q ^ K ∣ ∏ i ∈ Finset.range N, ∏ t ∈ Finset.range (μ.rowLen i), (1 - Q ^ (N - i + t)) - 1

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.dvd_prod_sub_one' {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (Q : R) (K : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) (g : ℕ → R) (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, Q ^ K ∣ g i - 1) :
Q ^ K ∣ ∏ i ∈ s, g i - 1

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.bsum_sub_dvd (μ : YoungDiagram) (N : ℕ) :
Polynomial.X ^ N ∣ (RSSYTSchur.bsum μ N fun (i : Fin N) => Polynomial.X ^ ↑i) - fmaj μ * DN N μ.cells.card

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.toPair_toTab {μ : YoungDiagram} {N d : ℕ} (hd : d < N) (p : MajStandardization.SYTe μ × (Fin μ.cells.card → Fin N)) (hp : (Antitone fun (k : Fin μ.cells.card) => ↑(p.2 k)) ∧ d = p.1.maj + ∑ k : Fin μ.cells.card, ↑(p.2 k)) :
toPair hd (toTab hd p hp) ⋯ = p

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.toTab_toPair {μ : YoungDiagram} {N d : ℕ} (hd : d < N) (T : MajStandardization.Cell μ → Fin N) (hT : RSSYTSchur.IsBT T ∧ d = ∑ c : MajStandardization.Cell μ, ↑(T c)) :
toTab hd (toPair hd T hT) ⋯ = T

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.toPair_mem {μ : YoungDiagram} {N d : ℕ} (hd : d < N) (T : MajStandardization.Cell μ → Fin N) (hT : RSSYTSchur.IsBT T ∧ d = ∑ c : MajStandardization.Cell μ, ↑(T c)) :
(Antitone fun (k : Fin μ.cells.card) => ↑((toPair hd T hT).2 k)) ∧ d = (toPair hd T hT).1.maj + ∑ k : Fin μ.cells.card, ↑((toPair hd T hT).2 k)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.toTab_isBT {μ : YoungDiagram} {N d : ℕ} (hd : d < N) (p : MajStandardization.SYTe μ × (Fin μ.cells.card → Fin N)) (hp : (Antitone fun (k : Fin μ.cells.card) => ↑(p.2 k)) ∧ d = p.1.maj + ∑ k : Fin μ.cells.card, ↑(p.2 k)) :
RSSYTSchur.IsBT (toTab hd p hp) ∧ d = ∑ c : MajStandardization.Cell μ, ↑(toTab hd p hp c)

noncomputable def QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.toTab {μ : YoungDiagram} {N d : ℕ} (hd : d < N) (p : MajStandardization.SYTe μ × (Fin μ.cells.card → Fin N)) (hp : (Antitone fun (k : Fin μ.cells.card) => ↑(p.2 k)) ∧ d = p.1.maj + ∑ k : Fin μ.cells.card, ↑(p.2 k)) :
MajStandardization.Cell μ → Fin N

noncomputable def QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.toPair {μ : YoungDiagram} {N d : ℕ} (hd : d < N) (T : MajStandardization.Cell μ → Fin N) (hT : RSSYTSchur.IsBT T ∧ d = ∑ c : MajStandardization.Cell μ, ↑(T c)) :
MajStandardization.SYTe μ × (Fin μ.cells.card → Fin N)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.entry_le_sum {μ : YoungDiagram} (y : MajStandardization.RSSYT μ) (c : MajStandardization.Cell μ) :
↑y c ≤ ∑ c' : MajStandardization.Cell μ, ↑y c'

theorem QOU.Mathlib.MajFormula.part_le_sum {μ : YoungDiagram} (x : (_ : MajStandardization.SYTe μ) × MajStandardization.DecSeq μ.cells.card) (k : Fin μ.cells.card) :
↑x.snd k ≤ ∑ c : MajStandardization.Cell μ, ↑((MajStandardization.stdEquivSigma μ) x) c
